task: Classify MLH1 silencing in gastric adenocarcinoma. Classes: No_Silencing vs. Silenced. Key H&E indicators for MLH1-silenced tumors include dense tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, mucinous change, poor differentiation, and medullary or pushing growth patterns associated with mismatch repair deficiency.

classes.0: Tumor without MLH1 silencing, more often showing conventional gastric adenocarcinoma morphology without prominent MSI-like inflammatory features.
classes.1: MLH1-silenced tumor with lymphocyte-rich, poorly differentiated, mucinous, or medullary-like morphology suggestive of mismatch repair deficiency.
